تفتضخي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَضِخِي (taftaḍiḵī) /taf.ta.dˤi.xiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# تُفْتَضَخِي (tuftaḍaḵī) /tuf.ta.dˤa.xiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
